proves.claim: Claiming a branch that holds its own commits launches no git status and no git merge, leaves its head, and prints one line naming how far behind main it is.

cli.io-item-folder.claim-skips-main-merg.why: Without it, the claim-time status scan and merge over the whole folder return and cost 30+ s on a loaded disk.

proves.claim: Opening such a folder with main 200 commits past its base takes at most twice the time of 1 commit past and under 1 s.

cli.io-item-folder.claim-cost-flat-with-.why: Without it, a claim cost that grows with main's history would pass unnoticed.

proves.claim: A branch with no commits of its own that is behind main still moves to main's tip by a ref update with no merge commit.

cli.io-item-folder.claim-fast-forwards-p.why: Without it, dropping the merge for branches with commits could also drop the fast-forward for plain ones.
